meta_description:
133 likes, 5 comments - sjanaelise on October 8, 2026: "💗✨🦋🌀😝 i used to think it was a terrible thing to be “intimidating”. I thought it meant I was personally responsible for someone elses insecurity.
The older I get, the more I realize that taking up space, shining brightly and embodying your most wonderful whimsical self is actually one of the BEST things you can do for other women.
Why?
A) you’re giving PERMISSION to other women to also shine their light super fucking bright! 
And B) because if you trigger, or are intimidating or perceived as a “threat” by another woman, you haven’t dimmed her light at all. What you’ve done is illuminated the parts of her that she is yet to work with - shadow aspects yet to be integrated. 
You’ve unknowingly handed her an invitation to step into rafical self awareness and growth.
A conscious, heart-led woman willsee this for what it is, do the work and thank you for being a part of her initiation - fir being a direct mirror for her.
Your brightness will not be shunned or shamed or attempted to be dimmed by another empowered woman. 
She’ll know that you’re not in competition with one another, instead you’re different parts of the whole ❤️🌹💫".
